afterImage.name: The AES Corporation
afterImage.subsector: Electric utilities and global power generation
afterImage.description: The AES Corporation is a publicly traded, U.S.-headquartered power and utilities company with regulated utilities, conventional generation, renewable energy, battery storage and related infrastructure across the United States and international markets. Its customers include regulated residential, commercial and industrial utility users, corporate and technology buyers, utilities and wholesale-market counterparties. AES remained publicly owned as of August 23, 2026. A consortium jointly controlled by GIP-managed vehicles and EQT Infrastructure VI signed an agreement on March 1, 2026 to acquire 100% of AES through Horizon Parent, L.P.; CalPERS and QIA are also participants. Stockholders approved the merger and the HSR waiting period expired in June 2026, but other regulatory reviews remained open and no legal closing was found. GIP, EQT, CalPERS and QIA are therefore pending buyers, not current owners.
